title: Together We Are Strong | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Sharing is Caring | BuBu TV - English
description:
A catchy kids song about two siblings who learn that one stick snaps easily, but five sticks tied together are strong.
It teaches sharing, teamwork, and the power of staying together.
Sing along with Papa, Amma, and the sticks!

Mine, mine, it's mine, it's mine!
No, mine, mine, mine, mine!
Grr, grr, grr, grr
Let's share, we're friends!

One stick, snap, snap, snap
Five sticks, strong, strong
Tick, tick, tick, tick
All together, we're strong!

Papa, Papa, come and see!
One stick, so easy, easy
Snap, snap, snap, snap
Broke in two, look at that!

One stick, snap, snap, snap
Five sticks, strong, strong
Tick, tick, tick, tick
All together, we're strong!

Papa ties, tie, tie, tie
Bundle up, hold it tight
Pull, pull, pull, pull
Nobody can break it!

One stick, snap, snap, snap
Five sticks, strong, strong
Tick, tick, tick, tick
All together, we're strong!

Hug, hug, hug, hug
Amma smiles, "Well done!"
Stay, stay, stay, stay
Together we are strong!
